summary.structural_decision_needed: Promotion needs a multi-axis aid-flow dimension this schema does not yet have: a dimension (aid_flow_stage x aid_instrument) capturing 4 stages (appropriation/target, expenditure/utilization, receipt, commitment) x instrument (grant/loan/total). Fiscal-year axis is BS (2058/59..2080/81) -> existing BS period handling covers it; unit npr_crore already supported; no enum/unit conversion needed for the accepted cells. Disposition decision required: this page is severely OCR-degraded (only 12 of 92 group-row identities foot), so recommend re-OCR / full-page Opus render-verify before bulk promotion rather than promoting 36 of 345 cells. The 36 accepted cells are render-confirmed and safe at confidence B; the 309 quarantined cells must NOT be promoted. Escalate: (a) add aid_flow_stage x instrument dimension via ADR, (b) decide re-extract-whole-table vs promote-the-36-now.
summary.note: Annex 2.24 foreign-aid matrix, 23 fiscal years (rows, independent; no row total) x 15 cols in 4 super-groups. Identity per row per group: anudan+rin == group aggregate (+/-9 crore). Surya-OCR is heavily degraded on this page (systematic leading-digit 1/9 misreads), so only 12 of 92 (group,row) identities foot. Each of those was render-confirmed at high zoom (4 agg/part cells corrected from the image) -> 36 cells ACCEPTED (worst accepted residual 1 crore). Broad totals (kul bajet/kharcha/prapti, cols 0/4/8) carry no foreign part-sum identity and no column-foot total row, so they are unevaluable and quarantined. All other cells quarantined with a per-cell reason. Nothing fabricated; no cross-source anchor provided.
